description: Tests the LP cost argmax hypothesis: dominant partition = argmax_λ |y_λ(q_0) · χ_q^λ(β_atom)|. The LP cost is the objective coefficient in the operator-selection LP (prop:operator-selection-lp). NEGATIVE FINDING: matches only T (1/3 atoms). For D the empirical dominant [2,2,1,1] isn't even in the top-5; for ³He [5,4] ranks 4th. This rules out the simpler LP-cost hypothesis and rules IN the full SDP shadow price y_λ^* (which is structurally different from the cost) as the next selector candidate. Substrate-only data from PR #638's per-eigenvalue probe. Class C.

data.conclusion: LP-cost-argmax hypothesis REFUTED. Rules in the full SDP shadow price y_λ^* (operator-selection-sdp's dual variable) as the next selector candidate; the cost is the LP objective coefficient, while the shadow price is the dual marginal price that emerges from primal-dual coupling — distinct objects with different empirical content.
